title: The Defias Across Two Generations
summary: The Defias Brotherhood's grievance, Edwin VanCleef's rebellion, and Vanessa's later vengeance form a generational history of Westfall and Stormwind.
opening: The rebuilding of Stormwind left a grievance that did not end with Edwin VanCleef. The Deadmines returned as a stage for his daughter's reckoning.
reviewNote: Verify the Stonemasons' dispute in primary quests or books and distinguish original from Cataclysm Deadmines.

chapters.title: After the rebuilding
chapters.body: Investigate the workers' grievance and how it became organized rebellion.

chapters.title: Edwin's Defias
chapters.body: Follow Edwin VanCleef and the original Deadmines conflict.

chapters.title: A daughter remembers
chapters.body: Examine what Vanessa witnessed and why she took up the Defias cause.

chapters.title: The Deadmines return
chapters.body: Trace the later dungeon story and what it changes about the Brotherhood.
